category_edits.rationale: Halve the configured history length, rounding up, to reduce stale-context interference and recurrent computation. Training, validation, and prediction retain the most recent causal suffix in chronological order through the existing MAXLEN and checkpoint metadata plumbing. All four category models retain their GRU architecture, readout, loss, and optimizer.

response.change_summary: Reduce default causal context from 128 to 64 across all four datasets, consistently using the saved context length during prediction.
